{{Quote|When I got shot down over Atrivis, it helped me evade the Storm Commandos until I could steal another ship.|[[Homack]]|<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
'''Atrivis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the same [[Atrivis sector/Legends|name]]. [[Homack]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], was shot down over the planet and pursued by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]].

==Description==
Atrivis was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]].<ref name="Placement" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought a battle over Atrivis. One of the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Homack]], was shot down in his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] during the battle and crashed on the planet's surface. He was pursued by [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]],<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', 50</ref> elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] units specially trained in commando tactics,<ref name="Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', 102</ref> but was able to successfully evade them with the help of a set of [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries]] [[Camo scout armor|Scout Armor]]. Stored in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] survival gear kit, the suit was capable of mimicking surrounding terrain by generating a small [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] distortion, thus enabling Homack to avoid capture long enough to steal a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and escape the planet.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Atrivis was mentioned in ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' ([[1997]]), in an [[in-universe]] message board post by Homack. "Atrivis" had only applied to a [[Star system/Legends|system]] and [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]; however, the context here makes a clear reference to a planet. Later, the novel ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'' refers to the planet [[Atrivis 7]], reinforcing this understanding.

An earlier [[West End Games]] sourcebook, the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' ([[1990]]), mentions an Alliance [[Battle of the Generis system|battle]] in the Atrivis sector; given the significant cross-referencing that occurs within West End Games products, it is likely Homack's crash occurred as a consequence of this battle.
